data.meta_summary: The current mid lane meta is defined by flexibility and macro-oriented playstyles. Success hinges less on individual champion picks and more on strategic adaptability, wave management proficiency, and jungle pathing synergy.
champion_insights: Champions who can exert early pressure and facilitate roams are highly valued.
Scaling mages remain a cornerstone for late-game teamfight dominance.
Diverse assassin archetypes provide crucial pick potential and disrupt enemy backlines.
Utility-focused playmakers enable team compositions to execute complex strategies.
data.itemization_philosophy: Optimal item builds are now situational and reactive. Core itemization has been replaced by a philosophy of adaptive build paths, responding to enemy team composition and game state. Prioritize components that enhance your champion's primary role within the team's strategic framework.
data.rune_strategy: Rune pages should be tailored to matchup and team goals, focusing on either laning dominance, survivability, or late-game scaling. There is no single 'best' setup, but rather a spectrum of optimal choices.
data.actionable_advice: Focus on improving your fundamental understanding of macro play, objective control, and vision. Champion mastery is secondary to strategic acumen in the current meta.
